checks.name: v10 schema and centralized salvage rules are present
victory derives a stable eligible offer and reload cannot reroll
pyrrhic uses the lower deterministic chance
defeat, withdraw and wiped are ineligible and cannot reroll
legacy, debug and missing/invalid settlement fail closed
first claim adds one deterministic instance and persisted provenance
second claim and double click are exactly once
claim before settlement, replay and other active battle cannot mutate state
formal settlement boundary and claim save-diff are isolated
salvage instance can be mounted normally after claim
v9 migration preserves old state, creates empty claims and no legacy salvage
claim sanitizer removes forged receipt and orphan salvage instance

legacyCutoff: salvageRulesVersion=1 only on new production sessions
